name: Gluta White SunBlock SPF 60 | Moisturizing & Brightening Sunscreen for All Skin Types
description:
Protect, nourish, and brighten your skin with Gluta White SunBlock SPF 60, a lightweight and non-greasy formula designed for all skin types. Enriched with Glutathione, Jojoba Oil, and Vitamin-rich ingredients, it provides advanced protection against harmful UVA/UVB rays while keeping your skin soft, hydrated, and radiant. Ideal for daily use, this sunblock prevents tanning, reduces oil buildup, and helps maintain an even, glowing complexion.Key Features:
 SPF 60 – Broad-spectrum protection against UVA/UVB rays
 Brightening formula with Glutathione for radiant skin
 Lightweight, oil-free & non-greasy texture
 Deeply moisturizes while protecting from sun damage
 Helps prevent tanning, dryness, and uneven tone
 Suitable for all skin types – men & women
 Ideal for daily outdoor useHow to Use:
 Apply evenly on face and exposed skin 10 minutes before sun exposure
 Reapply as needed, especially after swimming or sweating
 For best results, use daily as part of your morning skincare routineIngredients:
 Aqua, Arlacel 165, Emulsifying Wax, Jojoba Oil
 Titanium Dioxide, Zinc Oxide, Avobenzone
 Glycerin, EDTA, DMDM Hydantoin, Phenoxyethanol, FragranceCaution:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs

Package Includes:
 1 × Gluta White SunBlock SPF 60 (For All Skin Types)
